title: ALX Attribution Trace
description: Derivation graph structure computed from a root Block — captures path counts, depths, and lineage topology.
$comment: This schema validates structural shape only. It does not prove root membership, edge endpoint membership, leaf truth, depth correctness, pathCount correctness, or graph consistency.

root.description: blockHash of the root Block whose lineage was traced.

validationMode.description: Validation mode used during the trace: closed-world requires all parentHashes to resolve; open-world permits declared external boundaries.

complete.description: True only when all required lineage was resolved under the selected validation mode.

minDepth.description: Shortest path length from root to this node

maxDepth.description: Longest path length from root to this node

pathCount.description: Number of distinct paths from root to this node

parentCount.description: Number of direct parents this node has

childCount.description: Number of blocks that reference this node as a parent

leaves.description: Resolved nodes with no resolved parents. External parents are not leaves unless they are resolved as nodes.

missingParents.description: Unresolved parent hashes that were not declared as external boundaries.

externalParents.description: Unresolved parent hashes explicitly declared as external boundaries in verification context.

maxDepth.description: Longest path length from the root Block to any node in the trace.

cycle.description: True if a cycle was detected during traversal. Cyclic graphs are structurally invalid under ALX Protocol.

precisionLoss.description: True when pathCount values exceeded safe integer precision (2^53 − 1) during computation. Absent when no precision loss occurred.
